meta.position_basis_note: shares_held and holding_value are both the 13F-reported total over all legs (common + shares underlying calls + shares underlying puts); equity_shares / call_shares / put_shares break it down.

definitions.changes: changes (basis equity_filer_baseline): common shares only, option legs excluded; one filer CIK counts once per ticker; a filer is classified (new / added / trimmed / exited / unchanged) only when it filed a 13F in this dataset for the previous quarter-end. Filers with shares but no previous-quarter filing are counted in no_baseline and in holders, never as buyers. shares_added / shares_removed / net_shares and value_* sum only classified filers; value = |share change| x the quarter-end close.
definitions.dealer: DEALER marks filers on a hand-checked list of market makers and proprietary dealer desks (src/lib/dealer-filers.ts); their 13F positions are mostly hedge or market-making inventory. The list is curated, not inferred, so dealers missing from it are not flagged. Flagged rows are never removed unless the request says exclude=dealers.
